name: qbeta-skein-normalisation-admissibility-robustness
description: Tests whether the published Q_beta form's inadmissibility (z = 1, #6722/#6763) is an artifact of the (H) Skein normalisation AGENTS.md section 7a mandates, given that bean qou-8bxv measured a second normalisation (J) live in eight content blocks. It is not. The (J) algebra is the (H) algebra in u = sqrt(q) with the generator scaled by u^-2, so convention D's roots transport to zeta = u^-1 and zeta = u/(u^2+1); the second is exactly z_C. Under the reading that leaves the element unchanged, z = 1 is inadmissible in (J) at EVERY q > 1 -- stronger than the (H) result, which excludes it only because q_0 is not the supergolden root of q^3 = q^2+1. Under the reading that follows the bridge (d -> -s/2, -s), neither sign branch hits an admissible parameter. A negative control confirms the solver recovers an admissible parameter when one is present.

assertions.name: transport_carries_z_D_to_u_over_u2_plus_1
assertions.detail: z_D(sqrt q)/q - u/(u^2+1) = 0 exactly: convention D's second root, carried through sigma_J = u^-2 sigma~(u), lands on u/(u^2+1)

assertions.name: transport_carries_z_equals_q_to_u_inverse
assertions.detail: z~ = u scaled by u^-2 gives u^-1 -- the (J) image of the augmentation point z = q

assertions.name: the_transported_root_IS_exactly_z_C
assertions.detail: u/(u^2+1) - sqrt(q)/(q+1) = 0. NOT NEW: this is the one-line composition of markovZC_eq_kernel_sqrt and markovZD_eq_sq_mul_kernel, both sorry-free on main in QOU/BraidKnot/MarkovConventionSeparation.lean. Re-derived here as a check; the contribution is reading the q^2 rescale as the (H)->(J) Skein normalisation, not the algebra itself

assertions.name: the_two_admissible_parameters_stay_DISTINCT_under_transport
assertions.detail: u^-1 != u/(u^2+1) as rational functions -- the transport does not collapse the two roots into one, which would have made 'no branch matches' vacuous

assertions.name: C_reading_published_form_is_the_Z_equals_1_cell
assertions.detail: |h^2/2 - h| * E0 == published, exact over Q(q) on the branch 1 < q < 1+sqrt(2) where h < 2 -- reproduced here rather than carried over from #6722

assertions.name: H_admits_Z_equals_1_ONLY_at_the_supergolden_ratio
assertions.detail: under (H), z = 1 is admissible at exactly one q > 1, the root of q^3 = q^2 + 1 (supergolden, 1.46557123188) -- so the (H) exclusion at q_0 is a PIN fact, not an identity

assertions.name: J_admits_Z_equals_1_at_NO_q_greater_than_1
assertions.detail: under (J), neither u^-1 = 1 nor u/(u^2+1) = 1 has a solution with q > 1 (the second has none at all: q + 1 > sqrt(q) for every q > 0) -- so on the C-reading the published form is inadmissible under (J) IDENTICALLY, a strictly stronger statement than the (H) one

assertions.name: corpus_separation_theorem_STILL_HOLDS_under_this_transport
assertions.detail: 1/2 - kernel(u) has numerator (u-1)^2 >= 0, and z_D(q_0) = 0.612688037146 > 1/2, so no_kernel_instantiation_is_conventionD is intact: no real u sends the kernel to z_D(q). Nothing here contradicts it

assertions.name: the_transport_is_a_DIFFERENT_proposition_than_that_theorem
assertions.detail: kernel(u) = z_D(u)/u^2 holds identically -- SAME argument, rescaled by u^2 -- while kernel(u) = z_D(q_0) has no real solution at all. The two differ in exactly the binder the theorem leaves unquantified, which is why both are true and the da-arity-conflation trap is avoided rather than tripped

assertions.name: B_reading_hits_NO_admissible_parameter_on_either_branch
assertions.detail: solving s^2/2 - s zeta = +/- published/E0 at the proton pin over an UNRESTRICTED zeta gives +: -1.74118346683; -: 1.84557152509 -- two roots, neither equal to u^-1 = 0.9491671528 nor to u/(u^2+1) = 0.4993203342

assertions.name: NEGATIVE_CONTROL_solver_recovers_an_admissible_parameter_when_present
assertions.detail: re-running the same solve against a target synthesised AT each admissible parameter recovers it exactly ({'u^-1': True, 'kernel(u)': True}) -- so the NONE above is a finding, not a broken matcher

assertions.name: CALIBRATION_reproduces_the_merged_H_misses
assertions.detail: (H) at z = q gives 12.47002247 % and at z = z_D gives -43.15717529 % -- matching the +12.470 % / -43.157 % of #6722/#6763 to 3 dp, so the (J) cells above come from machinery already validated against the merged numbers

assertions.name: no_J_admissible_cell_lands_within_1_pct_of_CODATA
assertions.detail: every (J) admissible cell across both readings misses CODATA by more than 1 % (min |miss| = 5.5184338 %) -- the 0.17 % landing is not recoverable by changing normalisation, which is the whole question this probe asks

supergolden_note: under (H), z = 1 would be admissible at the supergolden ratio q^3 = q^2 + 1; q_0 is not that point
caveats: Delta_S is convention-laden (its typed-crossing shift d is a multiple of the bridge), and the corpus has no (J) version of it. Both readings tested here are CONSTRUCTED by this probe. Both fail, which is evidence for robustness and not an exhaustion over every element expressible in (J).

The identity z_C(q) = z_D(sqrt q)/q is NOT new here -- it is the composition of markovZC_eq_kernel_sqrt and markovZD_eq_sq_mul_kernel, sorry-free on main. What is new is reading the q^2 rescale as the (H)->(J) Skein normalisation.

Convergent with qou-cds1 (336a35ff278): kernel(q) = 1/[2]_q exactly, so markovZD = q^2*kernel(q) IS their rank-indexed z_N = q^N/[N]_q at N=2, and this probe's u^-2 rescale is exactly what strips that numerator. Their obstruction is STRONGER and supersedes the specialisation-point argument: D annihilates the (1^3) block and C does not, so no substitution carries a 3-block trace to a 2-block one.

That reading SUPPORTS the convention-C excision and does not soften it: z_C(q) = kernel(sqrt q) is the (J)-admissible parameter of the algebra at the variable sqrt q, not at q, so a z_C site is correctly normalised for the WRONG specialisation point. This is why such sites are not repairable by substitution (qou-cxjq, qou-lp5d, qou-pmkh, and the 13 blocked_on_rederivation entries -- 12 distinct files -- of the trace-convention registry).

Two arity gaps are checked, not asserted: no_kernel_instantiation_is_conventionD quantifies no rescaling factor, and no_rescaling_of_skein_weights binds one constant on the BRACKET at fixed q while this transport rescales the GENERATOR and substitutes q = u^2. Both theorems stand.
The symbol z_J is NOT used: bean qou-qlma owns it for a different number (0.0274199478). The transported parameter is written zeta.
Nothing here changes the published number or picks an option in bean qou-99qc. It closes one way that decision could have been dissolved.
